candidate_outcome_access: Only training outcomes through 1163 for association screening. Historical priors are inherited as already-causal inputs; no new label-based feature estimation.
global_rank_invariance: Global monotonic rank preserves daily Spearman against the same observed outcomes; an unchanged IC cannot prove incremental signal. Prefix checks audit ONLY the new transform, conditional on the previously verified parent feature panel.
interpretation: Reliance on time alignment of a fitted family, NOT causal importance or a retrained removal. Stable target identities are unchanged by within-target date permutations. Correlated alternatives and synthetic distribution shift limit interpretation.
permutation_contract: Shuffle 20-row blocks WITHIN each validation fold; identical row order for all targets and all columns in a family. Two seeds, no fitting. Diagnostic counterfactual inputs may use later validation rows; NEVER used as predictive features or promoted forecasts.
rank_formula: Average ties mapped linearly to [-1,1] among finite input values; global or within metadata horizon. NaNs remain NaN, no target label zero-fill.
shortlist_policy: Only innovation_horizon_rank candidates are screened: coverage>=0.70, >=40 eligible dates per training half, consistent nonzero daily Spearman sign, no exact duplicate. Up to six, sorted by minimum absolute half-mean IC. Global/horizon ranks are representation controls, not new sources of information.
validation_use: The three development folds have been inspected before. They diagnose existing frozen models only; the new candidate screen receives training rows only. No selection on the permutation scores.
